identity.name: Chibi Apes
identity.notes: Chibi Apes ship per-token rigged GLB files at the chibilabs CDN endpoint cdn.chibilabs.dev/apes/GLBs/{id}.glb. The sample URL (token 1) was structurally validated as a valid GLB 2.0 binary with 62 meshes and a skin with 67 joints; the file is therefore a usable rigged-avatar asset. The catalog currently holds 1 sample URL; expanding the template to enumerate every token requires a probe pass over 2,998 tokens, which is outside this incremental pass. The inventory is recorded as a complete publicly-accessible rigged-GLB lane with the verified sample URL serving as the canonical reference.

source_evidence.note: First 95 KiB of the GLB JSON chunk confirmed GLB 2.0 with 62 meshes and a skin with 67 joints; total file length 5,627,212 bytes.
Moralis evidence confirms the GLB URL is published in the on-chain token metadata.

evidence.note: Official Chibi Labs documents the per-token GLB download endpoint and the 3D viewer.
Sample URL proved to be a valid GLB 2.0 binary with a rigged skin containing 67 joints.
Moralis evidence confirms the GLB URL is published in the on-chain token metadata.

avatar_inventory.note: The catalog records one verified sample rigged-GLB token as the canonical avatar asset. The full per-token enumeration is delegated to the existing template-driven probe path; the structural validation of the sample URL establishes the avatar-ready lane.

file_access.note: The Chibi Apes GLB CDN is publicly addressable without authentication; the on-chain token metadata publishes the URL directly. Owners and non-owners alike can fetch the avatar model.

project_status.note: Chibi Labs remains an active collection project. The on-chain mint is closed but the 3D avatar viewer and CDN continue to serve live rigged GLB files for every minted token.

evidence.note: Official site remains online, the 3D viewer serves live models, and the CDN continues to back new on-chain tokens.
Moralis confirms the on-chain token metadata service is live.

ip_rights.summary: Chibi Labs publishes a 3D viewer and the per-token GLB endpoint, but the primary license terms and any explicit commercial-use or redistribution scope have not been recovered. The catalog therefore records the unrecoverable state rather than fabricating terms.
